## Goal

What question or concrete deliverable does this task address?

## Scope and owner

Owner (only if agreed), instruments/venues, dependencies and exclusions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A reproducible artifact or result is linked.
- [ ] Costs, data quality and failure cases relevant to this task are documented.
- [ ] Findings are reviewed before the next stage starts.

## Reproduction and evidence

Link the experiment record, data manifest, run configuration and findings. No secrets or restricted data.
